name: ritesh-firodiya
_: The site that publishes this system. It is included as a palette rather
than exempted, because a design system whose own host is the one surface
not measured by it is a brochure.
Renames applied: paper -> page, paper-2 -> muted, paper-3 -> sunken,
ink-inv -> ink-inverse, line-2 -> line-strong, accent -> brand-*.
Values are unchanged; this is a rename, not a redesign.
accent-2 (#a9452f) is LIGHTER than accent (#8a3324), so it maps to
brand-400 and not brand-600 — the ramp slot has to mean the same thing
here as it does in every other palette or the whole naming rule leaks.
No success/warn/danger/info: those four are not required, and this site
genuinely has no UI status axis. What looks like one is the release-state
scale, which is reserved below and means something else.
TWO INDEPENDENT AXES THAT MUST NOT BE CONFLATED, per the site's own
CLAUDE.md: m-* is the monetization model, live/beta/build/design is the
release state. A product can be free AND live, or subscription AND in
build. Collapsing them into one scale would make the products table lie.
The five model colours carry EQUAL weight on purpose. None of them may
read as a warning — 'this one costs money' is not a caution state, and
the moment ads or sub borrows the amber from warn, the table editorialises.
This is the same discipline as aakalan's pos/neg sitting beside
success/danger: money and correctness are different questions.
